# vergeio Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    vergeio = {
      source = "verge-io/vergeio"
      version = "2.0.0"
    }
  }
}
provider "vergeio" {
	host = "https://some_url_or_ip"
	username = "my_user"
	password = "my_password"
	insecure = false
}

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host Address of VergeOS
- `password` (String) Password
- `username` (String) Username

### Optional

- `insecure` (Boolean) Allow insecure connections
